## Ticket Triage Bot -- https://github.com/example-dev/ticket-triage
Tags: python, fastapi, rag, langchain
- Built a FastAPI service that routes support tickets with a RAG classifier over 12,000 past tickets.
- Used LangChain retrievers backed by a PostgreSQL vector store.
- Cut median first-response time from 9 h to 2 h.
